# Doit Then 1.0.22
- Improved recovery after granting Calendar and Reminders access. - Added privacy-conscious permission diagnostics to help investigate onboarding failures. - Improved guidance when macOS continues reporting an undetermined permission state. - Preserved existing planner, Calendar, Reminders, and licensing behavior.
An intermittent first-time permission issue remains under investigation. If it persists, diagnostic logs can help identify the cause.
